stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class); no Common Data Set was found on the LC State site. College Navigator fall 2024 shows 4,086 applicants and 88% admitted. IPEDS reports no SAT/ACT percentiles for this school, and no GPA, international-applicant or residency splits are available. Undergraduate enrollment (3,793; about 3,800 total including a handful of graduate students) and the 16:1 student-faculty ratio are from College Navigator, fall 2024. Many enrolled students are in associate and career-technical programs, not only bachelor's degrees.
